# Symaira Vault vault - ignore sensitive files
identity.age
.device-id
*.key
*.pem
# Ignore Symaira Vault runtime artifacts
mcp-token
mcp-tokens.json
.runtime-port
# Ignore OS files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
# Ignore IDE files
.idea/
.vscode/
*.swp
*.swo
*~

agents:
    claude-code:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: true
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.claude/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
    cli:
        approvalMode: none
        allowedPaths:
            - '*'
        canWrite: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        requireApproval: false
    codex:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: false
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.codex/skills/symvault/AGENTS.md
    default:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: false
        canRunCommands: false
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
    hermes:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: true
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.hermes/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
    openclaw:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: true
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.openclaw/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
    opencode:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: false
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.opencode/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
vault:
    authMethod: passphrase
    legacy_mode: false
    search_index: true
    scrypt_work_factor: 18
    auto_heal_zero_key: true
    format_version: 1
git:
    commit_template: Update from Symaira Vault
    auto_push: true
    auto_pull: true
    auto_pull_interval: 10s
vaultDir: <ROOT:0>

sessionTimeout: 15m0s
sessionMaxLifetime: 8h0m0s

stdout.text:
Manage Symaira Vault configuration including validation, profiles, and key-value editing.

Usage:
  symvault config [command]

Examples:
  # Validate the default config file
  symvault config validate

  # Validate a specific file
  symvault config validate ~/custom-config.yaml

  # Get a config value
  symvault config get vaultDir

  # Set a config value
  symvault config set agents.claude-code.canWrite true

  # List all config
  symvault config list

  # JSON output
  symvault config get vaultDir --output json

Available Commands:
  get         Get a configuration value
  list        Show all configuration values
  set         Set a configuration value
  validate    Validate the configuration file

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for config

Global Flags:
      --color string      When to emit ANSI color: auto, always, never (default "auto")
      --json              Output format shorthand for --output json; overrides --output when both are specified
      --no-pipe-warning   suppress 'reading from non-TTY' warning when piping secrets
      --output string     Output format (text, json, yaml) (default "text")
      --profile string    use a named vault profile
      --quiet             suppress non-error output
      --theme string      Color preset: default, highcontrast, colorblind (or SYMVAULT_THEME)
      --vault string      path to the password vault (default "~/.symvault")

Use "symvault config [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Configure AI agent profiles with scoped permissions, tokens, and MCP integration.

Use 'symvault agent install <name>' to create a security profile, scoped token,
MCP configuration, and agent skill package.

Usage:
  symvault agent [command]

Examples:
  # Install and configure an agent
  symvault agent install claude-code

  # List configured agents
  symvault agent list

  # Issue a token for an agent
  symvault agent token new claude-code

Available Commands:
  audit       Show audit log for an agent
  doctor      Check agent integration health
  install     Install and configure an AI agent for Symaira Vault
  list        List all configured agents
  profile     Manage agent profiles
  skill       Manage agent skill packages
  token       Manage tokens for an agent
  uninstall   Remove an agent integration
  upgrade     Upgrade an agent's security tier
  whoami      Show current agent context

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for agent

Global Flags:
      --color string      When to emit ANSI color: auto, always, never (default "auto")
      --json              Output format shorthand for --output json; overrides --output when both are specified
      --no-pipe-warning   suppress 'reading from non-TTY' warning when piping secrets
      --output string     Output format (text, json, yaml) (default "text")
      --profile string    use a named vault profile
      --quiet             suppress non-error output
      --theme string      Color preset: default, highcontrast, colorblind (or SYMVAULT_THEME)
      --vault string      path to the password vault (default "~/.symvault")

Use "symvault agent [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Store, export, and consume binary file attachments (e.g. a PKCS#12
certificate) through vault entries. Content is base64-encoded at rest, with
sha256, original filename and size recorded as attachment metadata.

Usage:
  symvault file [command]

Examples:
  symvault file add elster/cert --field cert_p12 --from ~/elster.pfx --shred
  symvault file get elster/cert#cert_p12 --out ~/elster.pfx
  symvault file use elster/cert -- java -jar elstertool.jar --cert $SYMVAULT_FILE_CERT_P12

Available Commands:
  add         Attach a certificate/key file to a vault entry
  get         Export a stored file attachment to disk
  use         Run a command with a stored file attachment materialized to an ephemeral path

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for file

Global Flags:
      --color string      When to emit ANSI color: auto, always, never (default "auto")
      --json              Output format shorthand for --output json; overrides --output when both are specified
      --no-pipe-warning   suppress 'reading from non-TTY' warning when piping secrets
      --output string     Output format (text, json, yaml) (default "text")
      --profile string    use a named vault profile
      --quiet             suppress non-error output
      --theme string      Color preset: default, highcontrast, colorblind (or SYMVAULT_THEME)
      --vault string      path to the password vault (default "~/.symvault")

Use "symvault file [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Unknown help topic [`lst`]
Usage:
  symvault [command]

Essentials:
  add              Add a new password entry
  delete           Delete a password entry
  doctor           Check vault health and configuration
  edit             Edit an existing password entry
  find             Search for entries
  get              Get a password entry
  init             Initialize a new password vault
  list             List password entries
  set              Set a password entry or field
  setup            Interactive setup wizard for Symaira Vault
  ui               Launch the interactive terminal UI

Vault:
  broker           Run the egress credential broker (loopback MITM proxy)
  dynamic          Generate dynamic secrets with time-limited leases
  file             Store, export, and consume file attachments in the vault
  generate         Generate a secure password
  recipients       Manage vault recipients for multi-user encryption
  run              Run a command with secrets injected as environment variables
  template         Generate configuration files from templates

Sharing & Sync:
  backup           Create a backup archive of the vault
  device           Manage paired devices for multi-device vault access
  export           Export vault entries to CSV or JSON
  git              Git operations on vault
  import           Import entries from another password manager
  intake           Review-gated credential intake from loose files
  remote           Manage git remote for vault sync
  restore          Restore vault from a backup archive
  share            Manage secret sharing between agents
  sync             Sync vault with remote (pull + optional push)

Agents & MCP:
  agent            Manage agent profiles
  approval         List and decide pending agent approval requests
  mcp              Start MCP server for agent access

Auth & Access:
  auth             Manage vault unlock authentication
  lock             Lock the vault (clear session)
  unlock           Unlock the vault and cache the passphrase

Manage paired devices that can access this vault.

Use 'symvault device pair' to generate a pairing token for a new device,
and 'symvault device join' on the new device to join the vault.

Usage:
  symvault device [command]

Examples:
  symvault device pair
  symvault device join ssh://user@host/path/to/vault.git <token>
  symvault device accept <token>
